title: Before Thy Cross We Take Our Place
description: Before Thy Cross We Take Our Place in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Greek Office Books (Paisley, 1904), headed “Troparia of The Sixth Hour”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Common Metre (8.6.8.6), and this page sets them to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Be-fore Thy Cross we take our place, With all our load of guilt, And plead for-give-ness of Thy grace Be-cause Thy blood was spilt.

lines: Before Thy Cross we take our place,
With all our load of guilt,
And plead forgiveness of Thy grace
For Thou, to free us from our foes,
And by its agony and woes
Bring gain for all our loss.
Therefore we raise with one accord
For joy and peace, O Christ our Lord,
We owe in full to Thee.

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Greek Office Books (1904)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Greek Office Books; set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
